Players Committee card image of [[Cal Alder (V)]] (original printing), game text: “May deploy as a 'react'. Deploys -1 to same site as a Rebel leader. Unless with Luke, opponent must first use 1 Force to fire a weapon at same site. Elis Helrot may not transport characters to or from here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/calalder.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
